integrity_statement: All new equalities are justified analytically, with a separate reproducibility checker as corroboration. Prior cited theorems are explicitly attributed. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to axis-aligned Euclidean squares of side two, widths strictly between zero and two, and finite families of planks; single-plank equality cases only. The global finite-family reduction invokes the published planar plank theorem and is not independently reproved. A historical equivalent calculation under other terminology remains possible.
title: Sharp partial-plank and translation-overlap phase transition for squares
